principle: THE NETWORK CARRIES TRUTH. IT DOES NOT CREATE TRUTH.

oyiEdgeCoreAudit.label: Luna Oyi Edge Core
oyiEdgeCoreAudit.preExistingDisclosureComment: Local digital-twin prototype placeholder, no real edge runtime connected.
oyiEdgeCoreAudit.finding: No connection to the physical network chain exists anywhere in canonical data. This phase disclosed that fact rather than fabricating a connection.

existingAssetsReused.role: core network gateway, real uplink_up field
Apartment 6A fiber termination, Facility demarcation point

runtimeGapFixed.issue: Asset existed in canonical registry with seededState {simulated:true, uplink_up:true} (Phase 10) but had no row at all in RUNTIME_SEED_ROWS.
runtimeGapFixed.fix: Added the missing runtime row using the exact value already declared in seededState — no new data invented.

physicalBackboneChain.mechanism: parentRef (pre-existing, Phase 10) — not the LUNA_ENGINEERING_RELATIONSHIPS edge array
physicalBackboneChain.note: resolveNetworkState().edgeCoreConnected is hardcoded to the TypeScript literal false, never inferred true.

relationshipTypeDecision.reason: The real chain is fully expressed via parentRef. EngineeringRelationshipType already includes connected_to/monitored_by/etc.; no new type was required for this phase's scope.

findings.note: Facility-owned demarcation point, pre-existing FACILITY_OWNED_UNIT_ASSET_REFS entry

targetPhrases: Is the fire panel connected to the network?
What connects the fire panel to the network?
oyiIntelligence.noSpecialCaseWrittenFor: What connects the fire panel to the network? — falls through honestly to a plain query with no network mention or fabrication.

doNotOverbuildHonored: no packet inspection or bandwidth telemetry
no new operational assets invented for schedule gaps
no new capabilities added to any of the eight prior systems

safetyBoundaries.provenBy: With the gateway uplink forced offline and the entire backbone cascaded unreachable, resolveFireState() and resolveHvacState() were queried directly and both still resolved complete, correct, fully independent state.
safetyBoundaries.cascadeScope: recomputeNetworkState() only ever writes to network/edge's own assets (riser, branch, ONT, router, Wi-Fi AP) — never reaches into any other system's state.
